name: Genie minimize
desc: Windows shrink into the taskbar like a Mac when you minimize them, and stretch back out when you open them.

name: Classic minimize
desc: The old-school Windows title bar that flies down to the taskbar when you minimize.

name: Zoom open
desc: Apps zoom open from where you clicked, like on a phone.

name: Sliding menus
desc: Right-click menus and tooltips slide into view.

name: Folder slide-in
desc: Folders slide and fade in when you open them in File Explorer.

name: Smooth scrolling
desc: File Explorer scrolls smooth instead of jumping in steps.

name: Selection fade
desc: The blue box you drag on the desktop fades out instead of vanishing.

name: Volume pill
desc: The volume and brightness pop-up turns into an animated pill.

name: Desktop cat
desc: A little cat runs around your screen and chases your mouse.

name: Mouse trail
desc: Your mouse leaves a glowing trail behind it.

name: Cursor fade
desc: Your mouse fades out when you stop moving it and pops back the second you move.

name: 3D wallpaper
desc: Your wallpaper moves a little with your mouse, like it has depth.

name: Color glows
desc: Animated light glows behind see-through windows.
